doc.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Her sick mother and being an only child
summary: Her mother was bedridden with heart trouble from rheumatic fever and her father cared for her and taught piano; Carla had no siblings.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: She was sick all of her life. She had heart problems from having rheumatic fever as a child. So she was in bed constantly. I hardly remember her ever standing up.
And my father took care of her and taught piano.
